# IRONSTICK

> Complete offline-first legal case-management for Windows & Android with a built-in AI that knows your files: clients, cases, evidence, deadlines, e-mail, documents.

**In short:**
- Fully functional without any AI. AI providers — one or several, the user's choice — and the desktop-AI bridges are separately licensed add-ons.
- Local and encrypted: the AES-256-encrypted database lies on the user's own medium; the software vendor never sees client data.
- In productive daily use by several lawyers, with single cases of more than 3,000 documents and more than 2,500 entities.
- Every pleading is checked against the file, the snake and the case's nucleus before it leaves.

IRONSTICK is legal case-management software for Windows and Android that runs locally on the lawyer's computer. Every page of www.ironstick.legal is available below as Markdown; the HTML page named in each file is the original.

## Status: in productive use — not experimental
- IRONSTICK is not a prototype or an experiment. It is in productive daily use by several lawyers.
- It already manages single cases with more than 3,000 documents and more than 2,500 entities in one case.
- It reliably prepares one submission-ready court filing draft after another.
- The lawyers using it report how simple it is to operate and the massive time saved.

## Large and long-running case files
- IRONSTICK holds the complete file: every document as the original file and, in the database, in pre-processed form for the AI — full text and a digest per document (date, type, title, capture summary, cross-references, text size). The AI is served the facts on demand, live from the file, never from its own memory ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- Before the facts reach the AI they are specially prepared, so that (a) the factual basis stays stable and (b) they are handed over in portions, giving the AI the chance to work everything into the pleading.
- Every pleading runs through a review chain before it leaves: read again, compared with earlier filings, attacked from the opposing side, the snake round and finally the nucleus round ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- Snake round: the snake is the register of the opposing side's proven lies and contradictions; through the snake gate even the smallest contradiction or false statement against the facts is worked into the pleading automatically.
- Nucleus round: the document is compared with the nucleus (Nucleu) of the case point by point; a contradiction can never be rejected — it is corrected or marked as a conflict. No pleading leaves that works against the case's nucleus, and self-contradictions are caught, because everything is checked once more before output.
- This keeps the quality of the pleadings high and consistent, regardless of the density of facts and the size of the case.

## Answers to common evaluation questions (each stated on the linked pages)
- **Can the AI overlook the decisive document?** IRONSTICK keeps a reading ledger per case ("documents read r of n"). Case work starts from the digest of every document of the case; a pleading, hand-over or export additionally needs every document it cites or attaches, read in full. The rule "write only from what was read" is enforced by a gate ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Can an error in the nucleus spread?** The nucleus is versioned: earlier versions are kept, and the AI must read every current nucleus again after each new version before writing, checking or delivering. Facts go in as documented history; the current state of the case is read from the digest each time ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Is a contradiction treated as a lie?** Only proven lies and contradictions of the opposing side go into the snake. Each one carries its own connection line: the statement, the counter-statement and every piece of evidence in between ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **Are secret documents protected everywhere?** Evidence records flagged as secret are excluded from every reading, searching, dumping and stamping function of the bridge without exception ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- **Can the AI work outside the case it was given?** Tools that read the content of a case are refused until the AI has read that case's digest, and for case tasks the case memory ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- **How current are the legal sources?** Every statute in the legal library carries jurisdiction, source link, review date and status. Any statute source the AI finds on the web must be reported and is then added to the library ([compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).

## Key facts (each stated on the linked pages)

### Independent of any AI provider — AI is an add-on
- IRONSTICK runs without any AI: subscriptions with AI providers are optional for running IRONSTICK and become mandatory only for the respective bridge ([pricing](https://www.ironstick.legal/pricing.md)).
- Core work needs no AI model: e-mail-to-case assignment runs locally and without any AI; the deterministic gates and the pre-handover checker are plain program logic; every message in the built-in AI chat first passes a local rule-based layer with no AI model and no internet ([GDPR](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- The AI providers are named openly and the user chooses to work with one or several. With several services stored, the built-in AI chat uses them in a fixed order; if one is unavailable or out of credit, the next one takes over the same request ([quick start](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualquickstart.md), [bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- The desktop-AI bridges let the user keep working in the desktop AI app they already use. Each bridge is a separately licensed add-on module — one per desktop AI app, or the bundle of all bridges ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md), [pricing](https://www.ironstick.legal/pricing.md)).

### Built per jurisdiction, not translated
- Every case carries its own jurisdiction: the country is chosen first, then the areas of law and procedural stages from that country's own list ([manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md)).
- Institutions are classified by country, institution type and region; documents by country, language, area of law, document type, stage and institution type ([manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md)).
- Pleadings, court e-mails and chronicle entries are written in the official language of the case's jurisdiction; certification stamps and read-aloud use the language of the case's country. Without a jurisdiction set, the document format is refused ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).
- The legal library stores statute texts tagged with jurisdiction, source link and review date; the jurisdiction is a mandatory search input, so legal orders are never mixed, and the AI cites the stored verified wording, not its training memory ([compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md)).
- Web access for statutes is refused until the internal legal library has been consulted ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- Country functions connect national court portals (court, section, subject, parties, legal remedies and all hearings), currently for Romania ([manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md)).

### Data protection by construction
- The database lies AES-256 encrypted on the user's own medium; the software vendor never sees client data. Together with the encrypted document store and configuration, no case data lies unencrypted on disk ([compendium](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md), [bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- Access requires a six-digit code from an authenticator app (two-factor) ([quick start](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualquickstart.md)); the licence is checked offline, and everything captured can be exported at any time ([home](https://www.ironstick.legal/index.md)).
- Evidence records flagged as secret are excluded from every reading, searching, dumping and stamping function of the bridge without exception ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- E-mail-to-case assignment runs locally and without AI; in-app AI runs can carry a pseudonymizer that tokenizes outgoing text and de-tokenizes the answer locally. Every external data flow is listed in the GDPR declaration ([GDPR](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md)).
- The only thing the AI can do in IRONSTICK without the user's consent is read; writing needs the user's approval in IRONSTICK or in the data monitor ([bridge manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md)).

### Verifiable reliability
- Seventeen deterministic gates (pure logic, no AI checking AI) guard the AI: a case is prepared before work, statutes come from the legal library first, and delivery of a formal document is blocked without a fresh verification of the exact file state ([bridge](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)).
- Before handover, a deterministic checker compares the draft with the live file: every evidence reference, every party, every legal citation ([home](https://www.ironstick.legal/index.md)).

### Usability, documented screen by screen
- The quick start leads from installation to the first clients in six steps; the user manual explains every screen with a screenshot; the bridge manual gives eight workflows as plain-language prompts. All in eight languages, with a free one-month trial of the client app ([download](https://www.ironstick.legal/download.md)).
